verdict.rationale: dlt's docs say it supports a variety of popular destinations and that destinations can be switched without modifying pipeline code. However, the only destinations the pack evidences by name are DuckDB and LanceDB. Snowflake, BigQuery, and PostgreSQL appear only as SQL sources, and cloud storage appears only as a filesystem source. Missing for 10: explicit destination evidence for Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres and object storage; hands-on or independent corroboration of destination swapping.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I load to the major warehouses and lakes — Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, object storage — without changing pipelines

citations.quote: This approach is especially useful when switching between destinations without modifying the actual pipeline code.
